title: 西班牙首相提前大选 住房法案受挫后寻求民意支持
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's get more details on the Spanish story right now, because Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has called for an early election after two emergency housing bills
segments.zh: 西班牙首相桑切斯在两项紧急住房法案被议会否决后，宣布提前大选。

segments.en: presented by the government were defeated in Parliament. Let's bring in Bloomberg's Rodrigo Orhuela in Madrid.
segments.zh: 彭博社的罗德里戈·奥胡埃拉在马德里带来报道。

segments.en: Rodrigo, what have we heard? What do we know? What does it mean for the politics of Spain?
segments.zh: 罗德里戈，我们了解到什么？这对西班牙政治意味着什么？

segments.en: So, what has happened is that Spain has, sorry, Sánchez has been struggling to gain support.
segments.zh: 情况是，桑切斯一直难以获得支持。

segments.en: He's seen his position weak and in surveys so far ahead of elections next year.
segments.zh: 他的地位显得薄弱，在明年选举前的民调中远远落后。

segments.en: And suddenly, the defeat the other day gives his camp, gives his coalition both his own party, the socialist and the junior party.
segments.zh: 而突然之间，前几天的挫败给了他的阵营、他的联盟——包括他自己的社会党和 junior 政党——一个重要的叙事。

segments.en: A big narrative to go into the elections and show that they are there or claim that they are there defending the right of people who need housing while the right who defeated his bills
segments.zh: 他们可以借此进入选举，展示或声称他们在捍卫需要住房的人的权利，而击败他法案的右翼

segments.en: the other day are against it. That's the narrative they're going to try to build on, the momentum they're going to try to gain.
segments.zh: 前几天却反对。这就是他们试图建立的叙事，他们试图获得的势头。

segments.en: And it offers them a small window in which they believe they'll be able to mobilize their voters, their constituency and have a chance of defeating the right,
segments.zh: 这为他们提供了一个小窗口，他们相信能够动员选民和选区，有机会击败右翼，

segments.en: the conservative P.P. and the far-right group Vox, who are set to win.
segments.zh: 即保守派人民党和极右翼Vox党，他们有望获胜。

segments.en: These two parties have a huge margin and now Sánchez clearly believes that he can chip away at that margin.
segments.zh: 这两个政党优势巨大，桑切斯显然认为他能逐步缩小差距。

segments.en: Rodrigo, were the polling to be correct and the right word to win and the P.P. was the head of government?
segments.zh: 罗德里戈，如果民调准确，右翼获胜，人民党成为政府首脑呢？

segments.en: How significant a policy shift will we see in Spain?
segments.zh: 西班牙将出现多大的政策转变？
